title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Care Desk Guidance: Closing a Card Account
content:
**Who closes.** Only the cardmember can close a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account. Customer care records the cardmember's request as a card service request for account closure, and the closure takes effect once the cardmember confirms it.

**Condition on a closure.** The cardmember's closure request is recorded as submitted, as the account's service request record shows.

**Accounts that can close.** An account in active or restricted status can be closed at any time, whatever its balance.

**After closure.** The remaining balance stays payable under the existing terms, including any special financing promotion until its own end; open billing disputes continue to their resolution; merchandise credits and credit balance refunds keep posting; and the Finch Circle membership is not affected.

**Annual fee refund.** When an annual fee posted within 30 calendar days before the closure takes effect, that annual fee is reversed in full with the reversal reason annual fee refund.

**No reopening.** A closed account is never reopened; the customer applies again, as a new application under the application and credit decision terms.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical accounts)

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| restricted account with a USD 900.00 balance; closure request submitted and confirmed | the account closes; the USD 900.00 stays payable under the existing terms |
| annual fee posted 12 calendar days before the closure takes effect | the annual fee is reversed in full as an annual fee refund |
| annual fee posted 45 calendar days before the closure takes effect | no annual fee refund under this clause |
| open duplicate-charge dispute at closure | the dispute continues to its resolution |
| cardmember asks to reopen a closed Store Card | a closed account is never reopened; a new application is the way back to a card |
